name: pdf-tools
description: Local PDFs: page count and metadata, text extraction, merge, extract or split pages, rotate, text watermark and images to PDF, on files in allowed directories

nodes.title: Read PDF info
nodes.description: Page count, whether the PDF is protected (encrypted) and what its publisher then allows (`permissions`), document metadata (title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, dates) and the size and rotation of up to 100 pages

input.description: PDF file inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or PDF_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Extract PDF text
nodes.description: Extracts the text layer per page (no OCR: scanned pages come back empty; use ocr-tesseract for those), capped at max_chars

input.description: PDF file inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or PDF_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

pages.description: Pages such as "1-3,5,8-" (1-based; default: all pages)

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Merge PDFs
nodes.description: Joins 2-50 PDFs in the given order into one new PDF

inputs.description: PDF files in order, each inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them. The one password is used for every input that is protected

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Extract pages
nodes.description: Copies the selected pages (in the order given, e.g. "3,1-2") into one new PDF

input.description: PDF file inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or PDF_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Split a PDF
nodes.description: Splits a PDF into several new PDFs: one per entry of `ranges` (e.g. ["1-2", "3-"]), or every N pages (default 1: one file per page); at most 200 files

input.description: PDF file inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or PDF_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

every.description: Pages per output when `ranges` is not given (default 1)

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Rotate pages
nodes.description: Rotates the selected pages (default all) clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees and writes a new PDF

input.description: PDF file inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or PDF_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

pages.description: Pages such as "1-3,5,8-" (1-based; default: all pages)

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Add a text watermark
nodes.description: Draws a text watermark (Helvetica, Latin-1 characters) on the selected pages: centred, top or bottom, rotated, with colour and opacity

input.description: PDF file inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or PDF_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

pages.description: Pages such as "1-3,5,8-" (1-based; default: all pages)

password.description: Only for a PDF that asks for a password when you open it, or to lift the restrictions its publisher set: that password. It is used to open the file and is not saved or shown anywhere. Most protected PDFs open without one; leave this empty for them

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Images to PDF
nodes.description: Builds a PDF with one jpeg or png image per page: pages sized to each image (fit), or A4/Letter with the image scaled down to fit and centred

images.description: jpeg/png files in page order, each inside PDF_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS

page_size.description: Page size (a4/letter turn landscape for wide images)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
